## Overview

Expose the engine's `stop_reason` (matched stop string or stop token id) on `/inference/v1/generate` responses in both frontends, and pass it through the derender endpoints so they match `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions`. Continues #47313 (@hhk7734, co-authored) and closes the `stop_reason` gap in #57052.

## Claims

- `GenerateChoiceBase` / `GenerateStreamChoiceBase` gain `stop_reason: int | str | None`, so every `output_mode` (tokens and text, batch and streaming) carries it. Python fills it from `output.stop_reason`.
- The Rust generate route reports the same field from `FinishReason::as_stop_reason` on streamed and collected outputs.
- `/v1/chat/completions/derender` and `/v1/completions/derender` (batch and streaming, plain and parser paths) carry the generate value through instead of always returning `null`.
- No wire change for existing fields; `stop_reason` is additive with a `None` default.

## Validation

Python (CPU only):

```bash
pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out/test_protocol.py \
       tests/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out/test_generate_stream.py \
       tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_stream.py \
       tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender.py
# 157 passed, 1 xfailed (unit; the derender e2e fixtures need a live server)
```

Rust (`rust/`):

```bash
cargo fmt --all -- --check                                               # clean
cargo test -p vllm-server --all-features --locked                        # 446 passed
cargo clippy -p vllm-server --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings  # clean
```

New tests: two generate tests in `test_generate_stream.py` (batch stop token id; streamed stop string with `null` on earlier chunks), two in-module Rust tests (stop string on a stream, stop token id on a collected response), batch chat/completion derender pass-through, and completion stream pass-through.

Not run: a live render → generate → derender A/B against a coupled server. @Yunzez's comparison on #57052 is the reference for that.

## Details

- **Why a new PR.** #47313 was opened in July against the pre-`output_mode` protocol and its author asked for it to be continued (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/47313#issuecomment-5924760857). The original commit is cherry-picked with authorship intact; the rebase moved the field onto the shared base classes introduced by #58588, which is why text mode gets it too.
- **Why derender needs it.** Derender builds its choices from the generate response and had no source for `stop_reason`, so it was `null` on every response (#57052, confirmed by an independent fuzzing run). With the field on the wire, derender passes it through in all five choice constructions. The batch stop pass in #59510 can then read it instead of re-deriving the match; whichever of the two lands second rebases.
- **Streaming nulls.** The Python stream chunk emits `"stop_reason": null` on non-final chunks, the same way it already emits `finish_reason: null`. The Rust stream struct is `skip_serializing_none` and omits it, matching how it treats its other optional fields.
- **Related, not duplicated.** #51904 adds stop-string *support* to the Rust generate route; this PR only surfaces the engine's `stop_reason` and doesn't change stop handling.

Duplicate-work check: searched open PRs for `stop_reason generate`, `47313 in:body`, `57052 in:body`; the only hits are #47313 (superseded by this PR with its author's agreement) and #59510 (consumer of this field, not a producer).

Co-authored-by: Hyeonki Hong <hhk7734@gmail.com>

Thanks. Pushed the rebase onto main plus a review commit:

- The two tests moved into `test_generate_stream.py` and go through `_mock_engine` / `_build_serving_tokens`; `_make_request_output` gained a `stop_reason` parameter. The `object.__new__` stub is gone with `test_stop_reason.py`.

- On the #59510 fallback: agreed, this lands first and #59510 reads `choice.stop_reason`. I've proposed the rule over there so the None/missing ambiguity doesn't matter.
Thanks. Comment reworded on both choice bases to say repetition detection sets it too and it's None on EOS, length and abort.

detail.body:
## Overview

Expose the engine's `stop_reason` (matched stop string or stop token id) on `/inference/v1/generate` responses in both frontends, and pass it through the derender endpoints so they match `/v1/chat/completions` and `/v1/completions`. Continues #47313 (@hhk7734, co-authored) and closes the `stop_reason` gap in #57052.

## Claims

- `GenerateChoiceBase` / `GenerateStreamChoiceBase` gain `stop_reason: int | str | None`, so every `output_mode` (tokens and text, batch and streaming) carries it. Python fills it from `output.stop_reason`.
- The Rust generate route reports the same field from `FinishReason::as_stop_reason` on streamed and collected outputs.
- `/v1/chat/completions/derender` and `/v1/completions/derender` (batch and streaming, plain and parser paths) carry the generate value through instead of always returning `null`.
- No wire change for existing fields; `stop_reason` is additive with a `None` default.

## Validation

Python (CPU only):

```bash
pytest tests/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out/test_protocol.py \
       tests/entrypoints/scale_out/token_in_token_out/test_generate_stream.py \
       tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender_stream.py \
       tests/entrypoints/scale_out/derender/test_derender.py
# 157 passed, 1 xfailed (unit; the derender e2e fixtures need a live server)
```

Rust (`rust/`):

```bash
cargo fmt --all -- --check                                               # clean
cargo test -p vllm-server --all-features --locked                        # 446 passed
cargo clippy -p vllm-server --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings  # clean
```

New tests: two generate tests in `test_generate_stream.py` (batch stop token id; streamed stop string with `null` on earlier chunks), two in-module Rust tests (stop string on a stream, stop token id on a collected response), batch chat/completion derender pass-through, and completion stream pass-through.

Not run: a live render → generate → derender A/B against a coupled server. @Yunzez's comparison on #57052 is the reference for that.

## Details

- **Why a new PR.** #47313 was opened in July against the pre-`output_mode` protocol and its author asked for it to be continued (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/47313#issuecomment-5924760857). The original commit is cherry-picked with authorship intact; the rebase moved the field onto the shared base classes introduced by #58588, which is why text mode gets it too.
- **Why derender needs it.** Derender builds its choices from the generate response and had no source for `stop_reason`, so it was `null` on every response (#57052, confirmed by an independent fuzzing run). With the field on the wire, derender passes it through in all five choice constructions. The batch stop pass in #59510 can then read it instead of re-deriving the match; whichever of the two lands second rebases.
- **Streaming nulls.** The Python stream chunk emits `"stop_reason": null` on non-final chunks, the same way it already emits `finish_reason: null`. The Rust stream struct is `skip_serializing_none` and omits it, matching how it treats its other optional fields.
- **Related, not duplicated.** #51904 adds stop-string *support* to the Rust generate route; this PR only surfaces the engine's `stop_reason` and doesn't change stop handling.

Duplicate-work check: searched open PRs for `stop_reason generate`, `47313 in:body`, `57052 in:body`; the only hits are #47313 (superseded by this PR with its author's agreement) and #59510 (consumer of this field, not a producer).

Co-authored-by: Hyeonki Hong <hhk7734@gmail.com>

Thanks @shimib, this looks good. Generate is the only place that actually knows the engine's stop_reason, so reporting it there and passing it through derender is the right fix for the null in #57052. 

A few things before merging:

- #59510 sets `stop_reason` in the same derender spots by working it out from the decode. I'd land this PR first and have #59510 use `choice.stop_reason` from generate, falling back to its own matching only when it's `None`. One catch is that `None` from a new generate host and a missing field from an old one look the same, so we should agree on that fallback over there.
- Could the two tests in `test_stop_reason.py` move into `test_generate_stream.py`? It already has `_make_request_output` and `_build_serving_tokens`, and adding a `stop_reason` param to the first covers it. The `object.__new__` stub also only works because `_logprobs_tokenizer(False)` returns before it touches anything that wasn't set. It will therefore break as soon as the generator reads a new attribute.
- Nit. The same `Field(description=...)` is copied onto both choice base classes, while the fields around it just use comments.

LGTM, thanks @shimib.

One small nit. The new comment says `stop_reason` is None "for any other finish" but repetition detection sets it too (`"repetition_detected"` in `vllm/v1/core/sched/utils.py`, and Rust `as_stop_reason` returns the `Repetition` payload). Maybe just say it's None on EOS, length and abort?
